scope: Store bounded graph-produced continuous internal tokens and objective post-commit event facts without persistent node/edge path history, value interpretation, eligibility, credit or plasticity.

representation.producer: generic graph readout ports selected by graph structure
representation.similarity: continuous geometry remains available for later approximate association

phase_order: activation updates graph state and emits bounded action potentials
graph-defined token readout compresses selected current node values
existing action arbitration and authoritative world commit execute
post-commit objective facts are paired with the token for later ticks only
persistent_record: stable carrier and resolved target subject identities
actual action resolution and sampled probability
objective body position information and raw-store deltas
resolution resource deltas and energy cost

retention.memory_scaling: entity-capacity times event-capacity times token-width; independent of graph node-edge capacity
retention.legacy_upgrade: Stage-2 payload rebuilds an empty token ring explicitly

forbidden: energy integrity resources information or reproduction assigned fixed subjective sign
weight topology or action changes caused by recording
knowledge relation group or diagnostic semantic imports
unimplemented: physical token-memory or computation cost debit
